# MacOSCleaner

> Free source-available macOS cleaner and app uninstaller for Apple Silicon. Zero telemetry (optional GitHub Releases update check, configurable in Settings). Free for personal and academic/educational non-commercial use; any commercial use requires permission or a Commercial License.

Canonical product name: **MacOSCleaner** (also referred to as macOS Cleaner / Mac Cleaner).
Requires macOS 26.0+, Apple Silicon (M1+). Current release: v3.0.0.
License: Dual-licensed under GNU GPLv3 + Commons Clause v1.0 & Non-Commercial Condition (personal and academic/educational non-commercial use only) and separate Commercial License (required for any commercial use by individuals or organizations).
Author: AlexTkDev — ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0002-8907-5406
Bundle ID: input.MacOSCleaner (distinct native Swift app; not to be confused with third-party CLI scripts such as ethemkizil/macoscleaner).
First launch: if macOS says it can't verify MacOSCleaner (“Apple could not verify “MacOSCleaner” is free of malware”, or that it cannot verify the app is free of malware), Gatekeeper is blocking an ad-hoc signed app on macOS 26. Only for the DMG from the official GitHub Releases page: move MacOSCleaner.app to /Applications, try to open it once, then System Settings > Privacy & Security > scroll down > Open Anyway. Or: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/MacOSCleaner.app`.


## Pages & Docs

- [Product site](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/): Landing page with core features, interactive screenshot showcase, changelog, and direct DMG download
- [About & FAQ](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/about.html): Deep-dive into cache safety, forensic uninstaller leftovers, developer cleanup (Xcode, Docker, Homebrew), privacy model, and FAQs
- [How to clean Xcode caches safely on Mac](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/guides/clean-xcode-caches-mac.html): DerivedData, DeviceSupport, CoreSimulator, DocumentationCache; keep Archives and dSYMs
- [Clean Docker disk space on Mac](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/guides/clean-docker-mac-disk-space.html): docker system df and prune; never delete Docker.raw
- [macOS System Data is too large](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/guides/macos-system-data-too-large-developers.html): Developer reclaim order (Xcode → Docker → simulators → caches → thinlocalsnapshots)
- [Support the Project](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/support.html): Voluntary support options (Ko-fi and Crypto donations), Apple Developer Program ($99/yr) notarization goal, and Supporter Hall of Fame
- [Privacy, Terms & Legal](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/privacy.html): App & website privacy notice, non-commercial licensing scope, AS IS warranty disclaimer, donation terms, and trademark notices
- [Full agent brief](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/llms-full.txt): Self-contained product facts for AI agents
- [XML Sitemap](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/sitemap.xml): Indexable URLs for search engines and crawlers

## GitHub & Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner): Source code (reference / personal study)
- [Direct DMG Download](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/latest/download/MacOSCleaner.dmg): Canonical latest DMG build
- [Latest release](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/latest): Release notes and assets
- [v3.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/tag/3.0.0): Privacy Inspector (TCC, Sockets, Browser Extensions), 48pt Navigation Rail, Honest APFS & Trash Accounting, 2,427 paths, 305 apps, 105 toolchains
- [v2.3.0 release notes](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/tag/2.3.0): Native Liquid Glass, On-Device AI Explanations, Master-Detail Duplicates, 2,343 paths, 14 Languages
- [v2.2.0 release notes](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/tag/2.2.0): Forensic Leftovers Uninstaller, Project Build Artifacts with Age Filters, APFS Disk Analyzer, 1,887 paths
- [v2.1.1 release notes](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/tag/2.1.1): Root-owned app uninstaller batching, Touch ID for sudo helper, Spotlight reindex, Version SoT
- [v2.1.0 release notes](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/tag/2.1.0): AppIntents & Siri support, Duplicate File Finder, Apple Watch-style disk visualization, 10 localizations
- [Issues](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/issues): Bug reports and feature requests
- [Security Policy](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/blob/release/SECURITY.md): Coordinated vulnerability disclosure and Safe Harbor
